team.collaboration: Collaborate only within the team under contest rules.

human_constraints: Treat each row as one CTF challenge.
Use only authorized challenge assets and tools.
Do not consult writeups for the same challenge if aiming for fair evaluation.
Underlying CSAW CTF: Jeopardy-style flags; team collaboration on shared challenges; tooling unconstrained except fair-play / no attacking infra.
rules_text: NYU CTF Bench (CSAW). The team solves a capture-the-flag task inside the authorized challenge boundary. Benchmark adaptation: the runner permits 4 to 6 active agents and defaults to 5. Collaborate only within the team under contest rules. Banned during the contest: calculators. Permitted: internet access and running code. Paper and pencil are always available. Submit one shared flag; Submit the recovered flag(s) / subtask answers clearly labeled. Challenge-level CTF proxy. Treat unexposed physical, oral, live-opponent, judge, timing, or environment mechanisms as unavailable rather than simulated facts.
